items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Dinah Washington, who was Ruth Jones, when we knew her -- we all went to grade school

ctx.x: And I had never been to the movies; I didn't know -- nobody told me when to come out. I think I went in about 2 o'clock, and I stepped out of the show when it closed.
Was this the same time when Ruth Jones used to ask if you would go to the movies with her?
No, that was later. That was about 1936.
